text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":10000,"unit":"gallons","kind":"count","span":"10000 gallons"},{"id":"q2","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"half the amount"},{"id":"q3","value":500,"unit":"gallons","kind":"count","span":"500 gallons of water per day"},{"id":"q4","value":6,"unit":"days","kind":"count","span":"after 6 days"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"divide the pool amount (10000) by 2 to find half, the amount put into the tank"},{"op":"mul","args":["q3","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply the daily emptying rate (500) by 6 days to find total water removed"},{"op":"sub","args":["s1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract total water removed from the tank's starting amount to find how much remains after 6 days"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"gallons remaining in the tank after 6 days"},"dismissed":[]}
